118557.note: No founding year found yet (Nov 9: first pass only: CrownHeights.info and lubavitch.com searched by name and director; not dug into yet). Rabbi Berel and Rivky Gurevitch came to run the campus Chabad House at the University of Oregon in late 2015 ('seven short weeks since we've been here', CrownHeights.info, 24 Jan 2016, https://crownheights.info/shlichus/519721/oregon-college-town-gets-infusion-of-jewish-life/); a Chabad House at the U of O campus in Eugene was already named in Sept 2007 (https://crownheights.info/shlichus/8210/chabad-reaches-out-to-students-faculty-at-metro-campuses/). Director: Berel Gurevitch.
